verse.verse_1: Nay, I swear by the Day of Resurrection;
verse.verse_2: and nay, I swear by the self-reproaching soul!
verse.verse_3: Does man imagine that We will not be able to bring his bones together again?
verse.verse_4: Yes indeed; We have the power to remould even his finger-tips.
verse.verse_5: But man desires to persist in his evil ways.
verse.verse_6: He asks: “When will the Day of Resurrection be?”
verse.verse_9: and the sun and the moon are joined together,
verse.verse_10: on that Day will man say: “Whither the refuge?”
verse.verse_12: With your Lord alone will be the retreat that Day.
verse.verse_13: On that Day will man be apprised of his deeds, both the earlier and the later.
verse.verse_14: But lo, man is well aware of himself,
verse.verse_15: even though he might make up excuses.
verse.verse_16: (O Prophet), do not stir your tongue hastily (to commit the Revelation to memory).
verse.verse_17: Surely it is for Us to have you commit it to memory and to recite it.
verse.verse_18: And so when We recite it, follow its recitation attentively;
verse.verse_19: then it will be for Us to explain it.
verse.verse_20: Nay; the truth is that you love ardently (the good of this world) that can be obtained hastily,
verse.verse_21: and are oblivious of the Hereafter.
verse.verse_22: Some faces on that Day will be fresh and resplendent,
verse.verse_23: and will be looking towards their Lord;
verse.verse_24: and some faces on that Day will be gloomy,
verse.verse_25: believing that a crushing calamity is about to strike them.
verse.verse_26: Nay; when a man's soul reaches up to the throat,
verse.verse_27: and it is said: “Is there any enchanter who can step forward and help (by his chanting)?”
verse.verse_28: and he realises that the hour of parting is come,
verse.verse_29: and calf is inter-twined with calf.
verse.verse_30: On that Day you will be driven to your Lord.
verse.verse_31: But he did not verify the Truth, nor did he observe Prayer;
verse.verse_32: on the contrary, he gave the lie to the Truth and turned his back upon it,
verse.verse_33: then he went back to his kinsfolk, elated with pride.
verse.verse_34: This (attitude) is worthy of you, altogether worthy;
verse.verse_35: again, it is worthy of you, altogether worthy.
verse.verse_36: Does man think that he will be left alone, unquestioned?
verse.verse_37: Was he not a drop of ejaculated semen,
verse.verse_38: then he became a clot, and then Allah made it into a living body and proportioned its parts,
verse.verse_39: and then He made of him a pair, male and female?
verse.verse_40: Does He, then, not have the power to bring back the dead to life?
